text:
maya: Heads-up — we need a compact set of metrics to ship a single-pane GPU capacity view for Hosted + Dedicated. High level: SM occupancy, per-GPU memory used, per-SM queue depth, and slot allocation counts. Can we sketch names/labels and retention?
chris: +1. Do we want raw per-second or aggregated? storage costs will explode if we emit at 1s for all hosts.
sanjay: For model routing and cost signals we need 95th/99th percentiles of occupancy and tail queue depth. Aggregates are fine.
devon: From infra side: we can emit 10s counters and produce 1m rollups. Also can export uniform labels: pool=(hosted|dedicated), region, instance_type, gpu_uuid, tenant_id (only for dedicated).
heather: UX ask: dashboard should support two modes: cluster-level heatmap (short windows) and customer-level historical (longer retention for Dedicated). retention needs differ.
liam: On alerts: we want queue_depth > threshold across >3 hosts for 5m -> trigger autoscaler. Need metric for active_slots and queued_requests per-sm.
chris: Proposed metric names (proto):
```
sm_occupancy_percent{pool,region,instance_type,gpu_uuid}
sm_queue_depth{pool,region,instance_type,gpu_uuid}
gpu_memory_used_bytes{pool,region,instance_type,gpu_uuid}
sm_active_slots{pool,region,instance_type,gpu_uuid}
```
Add histogram for latency per-infer: infer_latency_ms_bucket{...}
```
maya: +1 on names. For Dedicated add label customer_id and maybe cluster_id. Also need model_version tag to correlate regressions.
sanjay: model_version could be high-cardinality. Maybe only attach when route includes pinned model (optional label). We should sample it at 1/10 requests for spikes.
devon: Implementation note: runtime can emit occupancy by sampling KV cache lengths and active warps. We'll provide an exporter that aggregates per-SM and exposes at 10s. We'll also add a tag `emission_mode=sampled|full` to indicate sampling.
metrics-bot: Note: new metric schema PR required — see repo: https://git.redwood-internal/metrics/proposals/pool-snapshot. Opened #142.
heather: Dashboard pieces: 1) per-pool occupancy heatmap (bin occupancy by 5% buckets), 2) per-GPU memory sparkline with GCs flagged, 3) queue depth percentile trend, 4) allocation table for Dedicated customers.
liam: Query patterns: we need p95 occupancy over 1m windows for autoscaling and p99 queue depth for incident triage. Keep raw 10s for 48h, 1m aggregates for 30d, percentiles for 90d.
chris: Storage estimate: emitting 4 metrics * 6k GPUs * 6 writes/min -> ~1.44M samples/min. With rollups it's manageable but we should cap retention for hosted per-gpu to 7d by default. Dedicated customers can opt into longer retention.
maya: Action items: 1) eng-runtime (chris + sanjay) implement exporter prototype (10s) -> due end of week. 2) eng-infra (devon) add ingestion path + retention policy + sampling flag -> due next Wed. 3) eng-platform (heather) build dashboard UX + paging queries -> prototype next Tues. 4) alerts/autoscale (liam) define alert thresholds and test playbook -> follow-up meeting.
chris: One more: need a compact tag for model_family vs model_version to reduce cardinality. model_family ok at high-cardinality? we can use model_family and sampled model_version when needed.
sanjay: Agree. Also add quantization_level label (int8/4bit/float16) — affects memory used.
devon: Security: for Dedicated, tenant_id/customer_id is allowed. For Hosted, we must not emit tenant ids. We'll add anonymized tenant_hash for debug flow.
heather: UX note: add a toggle to switch between pool-level and customer-level views. For dedicated we should show mapped SLAs and committed capacity.
metrics-bot: @maya Assigned: PR #142 reviewers: devon, heather. Please add schema docs and example Grafana dashboards to the PR.
maya: Thanks — will put the follow-up meeting on calendar with eng-runtime + infra + platform + sres. Quick sync 30m tomorrow 10:30am PT. If anyone can't make, post blockers here.
liam: FYI I ran a quick script on a staging pool — queue_depth spikes correlate with small-model bursts. We'll include a sample query in the PR.
sanjay: I'll include sample PromQL and proto exporter snippet in PR. Example: `rate(sm_queue_depth[1m]) by (pool,instance_type)`
chris: Good. If we all agree on names I'll open the exporter PR today.
maya: Agreement here — thanks team. Keep replies short if you have objections.
